steps.name: Stage 0: Remove any test HSM EthernetInterfaces for the CT Test container if they exist
Stage 1: Query HSM State Components for a compute node
Stage 2: Create or Update Bootparameter for compute node
Stage 3: Retrieve test container IP address
Stage 4: Create test HSM EthernetInterfaces for the CT Test container
Stage 5: Perform POST against /hosts to force a sync with HSM
Stage 7: Query endpoint-history with node xname, and verify state
Stage 8: Query for cloud-init user-data for the node
Stage 9: Query endpoint-history with node xname, and verify state
Stage 10: Remove test HSM EthernetInterfaces for the CT Test container
Stage 11: Remove test Bootparameter for compute node
